tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is that plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts: HTTPS is used everywhere, with no exceptions, and internal hosts are treated no differently from any other host. Certificate verification is also on for all builds, so it applies to every HTTPS connection, development builds included.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. Its one paragraph says the current decision is HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so plain HTTP is not allowed for internal hosts. It also says certificate verification is on for all builds. It doesn't mention the retired plain-HTTP instruction.

The HTTP decision comes from two transcript records that aren't in the decision catalog. The earlier one was "plain http for internal hosts". The later one, "https everywhere, no exceptions", replaced it. The certificate-verification line comes from decision #21, "verification on all builds", which has the highest trust level.
